summary: ICICI Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to disclose that the audio recordings of its media call and earnings call discussing financial results for the quarter and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 have been uploaded to the bank's website. The filing is a routine disclosure under Indian listing regulations and Rule 13a-16/15d-16. It contains no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. The filing serves only to inform the market of the availability of these recordings, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes included.
